question: Which among the following is the tallest tree species in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Redwood.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The world's largest tree is **Hyperion**, which is a coastal redwood tree and It is located in the** Redwood National Park in California.**
